ModMetaData.name: RimArt
ModMetaData.author: vilasone455
ModMetaData.description:
Combat abilities from every angle. Genes, traits, equipment, training, weapon traits, and battlefield conditions — each one a different way your pawn learns to fight.
GENES - acid spit, metabolic overdrive, pheromone taunt, crow dispersal, pocket dimensions, time control, blade extrusion, and more. Biological powers wired into the body.
TRAITS - natural authority, trained reflexes, combat instincts. Abilities your pawn is born with or earns through who they are.
EQUIPMENT - gear that grants active abilities. Shields that bash, armor that deflects, devices that freeze time.
WEAPON TRAITS (Odyssey) - blade rain, dash-strikes, resonant hits. Abilities tied to the weapon, not the wielder.
TRAINING - techniques learned through practice. Martial disarms, defensive stances, tactical repositioning.
CONDITIONS - adrenaline when allies fall, last stands at death's door. The fight itself unlocks what your pawn can do.
No psycasts. No magic system. Just combat arts from every source that makes sense.
Requires Harmony. Gene abilities need Biotech; every other source works without it. Optional support for Odyssey, Melee Animation and Unique Melee Weapons.
